def annotate_peak(ax, x, y, color, offset_y=0.01):

    ax.annotate(f'L{peak_idx}', xy=(peak_idx, y[peak_idx]),
                xytext=(peak_idx + 1.5, y[peak_idx] + offset_y),
                fontsize=8, color=color, fontweight='bold',
